svg.aria-label: How an answer comes to be: CVs are generated and indexed before use; at question time Gemini loops over typed tools that read the index and Pinecone, ends with present, and the app checks every candidate and page before the answer streams to the chat.
svg.title: How an answer comes to be
svg.desc: Before use, npm run generate has Gemini write 30 CV PDFs; npm run index has Gemini extract a profile from each, the field check locates every fact in the text so each has a page, and each chunk is embedded. The stores are data/index, JSON held in memory, and Pinecone, the chunk vectors. At question time the chat screen sends the question and history to POST /api/ask, whose prompt holds no CV text. Gemini runs a tool-calling loop: find_candidates, count_candidates and get_candidates query the index exactly; search_cv_text embeds the query and fuses BM25 with the vector search by reciprocal rank fusion. The loop ends with present. The answer check keeps only the candidates and pages the tools returned and has the app write the counts, then the answer streams to the chat, whose source links open GET /api/cvs/id, the PDF at the cited page.
svg.text: Before use: npm run generate, npm run index
